decisions.OI falling: FILTER: skipping signals when open interest fell over the last 24h improved results in both halves (a lot in the first, a little in the second).
decisions.OI exhaustion: FILTER (part of the OI rule): those signals lost in both halves.
decisions.Big unlock ahead: INFO ONLY: helped in the second half but hurt in the first; few signals affected.
decisions.OI rising +5%: INFO ONLY (+1 score): much better in the first half, worse in the second.
decisions.Crowded funding: INFO ONLY: only 1 signal in 90 days hit it, nothing to test.
decisions.Fundamentals rising, price lagging: INFO ONLY (+1 score): those signals did better in both halves, but too few (81) to filter on.
decisions.Stand-alone unlock / fundamentals signal: OFF: all three lost money after fees.
decisions.Coin gate: FILTER, modest evidence: coins picked on the first half did far better on the second half than the dropped ones (about break-even vs clearly losing); the reverse check showed almost no difference.
decisions.Sectors, listings, on-chain: No free history to test: shown as information; on-chain signals are labelled untested.

v3 + caps + coin gate (walk-forward).note: H2 uses coins picked on H1; H1 uses coins picked on H2
